name: opencode-permission-rule-set
body: An agent's opencode 2.x permission model: one ordered `permissions` array of `{ action, resource, effect }` rules. opencode evaluates the ordered rule set, and the plugin guide states that session-scoped rules are evaluated after the agent's rules with the last matching rule winning — the precedence apg's agent templates and fs tools rely on, so an allow broadened by a later deny narrows again. The action vocabulary is opencode 2.x's — `shell`, `subagent`, `edit`, and the apg-suite tool actions — and the per-tool grants over the apg suite and the opencode built-ins appear as action rules. Each distributed and generated agent carries one such rule set.
